test_title: RRB NTPC CBT 2 (Level-2) Official Paper (Held On: 13 June 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: TANWA was a project initiated in the late 1980s in Tamil Nadu to train women in latest agricultural techniques and organic farming. What is the full form of TANWA?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tamil Nadu Women in Agriculture**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Tamil Nadu Women in Agriculture (**TANWA**) is a project initiated in Tamil Nadu to train women in the latest agricultural techniques.
 
• It induces women to actively participate in raising **agricultural productivity** and** family income**.
 
• In the late** 80s**, a number of women agricultural officers were roped in to take the benefits of natural farming far and wide in Tamil Nadu, apart from** Odisha **and **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• The skills taught under TANWA include increasing **fertilizer use efficiency**, organic manure conservation **Farm Yard Manure** (**FYM**), compost-enriched , use of biofertilizer, tree cropping, field identification of pest/diseases, seed treatment,** rat control**, and **grain storage.**
 
• With the accumulated savings, they promote small-scale household activities like **mushroom cultivation**, **soap manufacture**, **doll making**, or** other income-generating activities**.
